# add_noise! {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
add_noise!(vec, dist)
```
Add standard-uniform noise to each element of `vec` in-place if `dist` is a `DiscreteDistribution`, in order to break ties before computing ordinal patterns. If `dist` is a `ContinuousDistribution`, `vec` is returned unchanged.
 


:::
